items.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 5 at 6:29PM EDT until September 5 at 7:30PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
SVRILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
New Hanover County in southeastern North Carolina...
Southeastern Pender County in southeastern North Carolina...
Brunswick County in southeastern North Carolina...
Southeastern Columbus County in southeastern North Carolina...
Northeastern Georgetown County in northeastern South Carolina...
Horry County in northeastern South Carolina...
South central Marion County in northeastern South Carolina...

* Until 730 PM EDT.

* At 629 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Cape Fear Community College North Campus to
Makatoka to Horry, moving south at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor hail damage to vehicles is possible. Expect wind
damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Wilmington, Myrtle Beach, Conway, North Myrtle Beach, Leland, Oak
Island, Carolina Beach, Surfside Beach, Shallotte, Sunset Beach,
Wrightsville Beach, Kure Beach, Holden Beach, Ocean Isle Beach,
Caswell Beach, Bald Head Island, Pawleys Island, Snows Cut,
Murrells Inlet, and Little River Entrance.
items.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Please send your reports of hail or wind damage, including trees or
large limbs downed, by calling the National Weather Service office in
Wilmington at 1 800 697 3901.

items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 5 at 5:59PM EDT until September 5 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
SMWILM

The National Weather Service in Wilmington has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Cape Fear NC to Little River Inlet SC out 20
NM...
Coastal waters from Little River Inlet to Murrells Inlet SC out 20
NM...
Coastal waters from Murrells Inlet to South Santee River SC out 20
NM...
Coastal waters from Surf City to Cape Fear NC out 20 nm...
Waters from Little River Inlet SC to South Santee River SC from 20
to 60 NM...
Waters from Surf City NC to Little River Inlet SC from 20 to 60
NM...

* Until 800 PM EDT.

* At 558 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 14 nm northwest of Surf City to 22 nm north of
Holden Beach to 34 nm northwest of Myrtle Beach, moving east at 35
knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Ten Mile Reef, Wreck 33, Masonboro Sea Buoy, Frying Pan Shoals
Buoy, Harris Reef, City Of Houston, 10 Mile Rocks, Little River Sea
Buoy, Gary Ennis Reef, Sheepshead Rock, Buoy Off Carolina Beach,
Frying Pan Shoals Light Tower, Wr2, Wr4, Sherman Wreck, Bill Perry
Junior Reef, Cape Fear Knuckle Buoy, 5 Mile Boxcars, Sunset Mid
Shelf Buoy, and 10 Mile Boxcars.
items.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.
If caught on the open water, prepare for deteriorating conditions.
Make sure you and your crew are wearing properly fitted life jackets.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
